title: Area formula on rectifiable sets with J^M f = ‖L_#ξ‖ (Simon Ch. 3, 2.4–2.5)
statement: Let U ⊆ ℝ^P be open, IsRectifiableTriple U n M θ ξ, f locally Lipschitz on U, and L : ℝ^P → L(ℝ^P, ℝ^Q) Hⁿ⌞M-a.e. strongly measurable such that for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ M, t ↦ f(x + tv) has derivative L(x)v at 0 for every v in every weighted approximate tangent space of (M, θ) at x. Then for every Hⁿ-null-measurable A ⊆ M and every Hⁿ⌞A-a.e. measurable h : ℝ^P → [0, ∞], the fibre-sum function y ↦ Σ_{x ∈ A ∩ f⁻¹(y)} h(x) is Hⁿ-a.e. measurable on ℝ^Q and ∫_A h(x)‖L(x)_#ξ(x)‖ dHⁿ(x) = ∫_{ℝ^Q} Σ_{x ∈ A ∩ f⁻¹(y)} h(x) dHⁿ(y).
lean_statement: ∀ (P Q n : ℕ) (U M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) n) (f : Eucl P → Eucl Q) (L : Eucl P → (Eucl P →L[ℝ] Eucl Q)), IsOpen U → IsRectifiableTriple U n M θ ξ → LocallyLipschitzOn U f → (∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict M), ∀ Tx : Submodule ℝ (Eucl P), HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ x Tx → ∀ v ∈ Tx, HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => f (x + t • v)) (L x v) 0) → AEStronglyMeasurable L ((μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict M) → ∀ (A : Set (Eucl P)) (h : Eucl P → ℝ≥0∞), A ⊆ M → NullMeasurableSet A (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) → AEMeasurable h ((μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict A) → AEMeasurable (fun y => ∑' x : {x : Eucl P // x ∈ A ∧ f x = y}, h x) (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q)) ∧ ∫⁻ x in A, h x * ‖nVectorPushforward n (L x) (ξ x)‖ₑ ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) = ∫⁻ y, ∑' x : {x : Eucl P // x ∈ A ∧ f x = y}, h x ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q))
